--[[
    Anti-Kick Universal Script
    Funciona em: Synapse, Krnl, Fluxus, Delta, Hydrogen, etc.
    Ativa automaticamente ao executar
]]

-- Configurações
local config = {
    antiKick = true,        -- Bloqueia kicks
    antiDisconnect = true,  -- Bloqueia desconexões forçadas
    antiTeleport = true,    -- Bloqueia teleportes forçados
    notify = true,          -- Notifica quando algo for bloqueado
}

-- Serviços
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Detectar executor
local executor = "Desconhecido"
if syn then executor = "Synapse"
elseif KRNL_LOADED then executor = "Krnl"
elseif Fluxus then executor = "Fluxus"
elseif identifyexecutor then executor = pcall(function() executor = identifyexecutor() end)
end

-- Função de notificação
local function notify(title, text)
    if not config.notify then return end
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = title,
            Text = text,
            Duration = 3,
        })
    end)
end

-- Bloquear Kick
local oldKick
oldKick = hookfunction(LocalPlayer.Kick, function(self, message)
    if config.antiKick then
        notify("Anti-Kick", "Kick bloqueado: " .. tostring(message))
        return
    end
    return oldKick(self, message)
end)

-- Bloquear Disconnect (método alternativo)
local oldDisconnect
if LocalPlayer.Disconnect then
    oldDisconnect = hookfunction(LocalPlayer.Disconnect, function(self)
        if config.antiDisconnect then
            notify("Anti-Kick", "Disconnect bloqueado")
            return
        end
        return oldDisconnect(self)
    end)
end

-- Proteção contra Teleport forçado
local oldTeleport
if LocalPlayer.Teleport then
    oldTeleport = hookfunction(LocalPlayer.Teleport, function(self, ...)
        if config.antiTeleport then
            notify("Anti-Teleport", "Teleporte bloqueado")
            return
        end
        return oldTeleport(self, ...)
    end)
end

-- Detectar e bloquear via RemoteEvents (tentativa de kick por servidor)
local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
local oldNamecall = mt.__namecall

setreadonly(mt, false)
mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
    local method = getnamecallmethod()
    local args = {...}
    
    if config.antiKick then
        -- Bloqueia kicks vindos do servidor via remotes comuns
        if method == "Fire" or method == "InvokeServer" then
            if self.Name == "Kick" or self.Name == "Disconnect" then
                notify("Anti-Kick", "Tentativa de kick via remote bloqueada")
                return
            end
        end
    end
    
    return oldNamecall(self, ...)
end)
setreadonly(mt, true)

-- Notificação inicial
notify("Anti-Kick", "Ativado com sucesso! (" .. executor .. ")")

-- Loop de proteção contínua (re-aplica hooks se necessário)
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(5) do
        pcall(function()
            if config.antiKick and not hookmetamethod then
                -- Re-hook básico caso algo tenha resetado
            end
        end)
    end
end)

print("[Anti-Kick] Script carregado | Executor: " .. executor)

    local tickTime = tick() * 5
    local r = math.sin(tickTime) * 127 + 128
    local g = math.sin(tickTime + 2) * 127 + 128
    local b = math.sin(tickTime + 4) * 127 + 128
    return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)

        FOVBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
    end
end)

PlusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    getgenv().FOVRadius = math.min(getgenv().FOVRadius + 20, 400)
    FOVLabel.Text = "FOV Size: " .. tostring(getgenv().FOVRadius)
end)

-- ปรับลดขนาดวงกลม
MinusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    getgenv().FOVRadius = math.max(getgenv().FOVRadius - 20, 20)
    FOVLabel.Text = "FOV Size: " .. tostring(getgenv().FOVRadius)
end)

-- ฟังก์ชันค้นหาเป้าหมาย
local function GetTarget()
    local target = nil
    local shortestDist = math.huge
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    local screenPos = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
                    local dist = (screenPos - screenCenter).Magnitude

                    if getgenv().AimbotMode == "Closest" then
                        if dist < shortestDist then
                            shortestDist = dist
                            target = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                        end
                    elseif getgenv().AimbotMode == "FOV" then
                        if dist <= getgenv().FOVRadius and dist < shortestDist then
                            shortestDist = dist
                            target = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return target
end

-- ลูปการทำงานล็อกเป้า
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if getgenv().AimbotEnabled then
        local targetPart = GetTarget()
        if targetPart then
            Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, targetPart.Position)
        end
    end
end)

local function groundY(pos)
    local r = Workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -1000, 0), rayParams)
    return r and r.Position.Y or nil
end

    * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)

local function weldTo(p0, p1)
    local w = Instance.new("Weld")
    w.Part0 = p0
    w.Part1 = p1
    w.C0 = p0.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p1.CFrame)
    w.Parent = p0
    return w
end

local function addPart(size, offset, color, material, shape)
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Size = size
    p.CFrame = dronePart.CFrame * offset
    p.Color = color
    p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    if shape then p.Shape = shape end
    p.CanCollide = false
    p.Massless = true
    p.Parent = droneModel
    return p, weldTo(dronePart, p)
end

local function makeStick(pos, caption, callback)
    local base = make("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 100),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = pos,
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Active = true,
    }, screenGui)
    roundify(base, 50)
    make("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -16),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = caption,
        TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
        TextSize = 10,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    }, base)
    local knob = make("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 235),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, base)
    roundify(knob, 20)

    local active
    local function update(p)
        local center = base.AbsolutePosition + base.AbsoluteSize / 2
        local maxR = base.AbsoluteSize.X / 2 - 8
        local delta = Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y) - center
        if delta.Magnitude > maxR then delta = delta.Unit * maxR end
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, delta.X, 0.5, delta.Y)
        callback(Vector2.new(delta.X / maxR, -delta.Y / maxR))
    end
    local function reset()
        active = nil
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        callback(Vector2.zero)
    end

    base.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            active = input
            update(input.Position)
        end
    end)
    table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not active then return end
        if input == active
            or (active.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
            update(input.Position)
        end
    end))
    table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input == active then reset() end
    end))
end

    local target = math.atan2(-v.X, -v.Z)

    yaw = yaw + diff * math.min(1, dt * 4)
end

-- Ciclo principal
table.insert(conns, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not dronePart.Parent then cleanup() return end

    local pos = dronePart.Position
    local gy = groundY(pos)
    local minY = gy and (gy + 0.9) or -math.huge
    local yawIn, vertIn, strafeIn, fwdIn = getInput()
    local inputMag = math.abs(yawIn) + math.abs(vertIn) + math.abs(strafeIn) + math.abs(fwdIn)

    local vel = Vector3.zero
    local tiltF, tiltS = 0, 0

    if flying then
        battery = math.max(0, battery - dt * (0.5 + curVel.Magnitude / 80))
        if battery <= 0 and mode ~= "land" then
            setMode("land")
            toast("🔋 Bateria vazia, a aterrar")
        end
        if inputMag > 0.2 and battery > 0 and (mode == "rth" or mode == "follow" or mode == "land") then
            setMode("manual")
        end

        if mode == "takeoff" then
            vel = Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
            if pos.Y - (gy or (pos.Y - 3)) >= 3 then setMode("manual") end
        elseif mode == "manual" then
            yaw = yaw - yawIn * dt * YAW_SPEED
            local horiz = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0):VectorToWorldSpace(
                Vector3.new(strafeIn * SPEED, 0, -fwdIn * SPEED))
            vel = horiz + Vector3.new(0, vertIn * VSPEED, 0)
            tiltF, tiltS = fwdIn, strafeIn
        elseif mode == "rth" then
            local d = homePos() - pos
            local flat = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z)
            if flat.Magnitude > 3 then

    end

        local dist = (pos - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
